# Inkvoy UI references

Pinned source and font hashes are in origin.json. The shadcn MIT command and sidebar sources were studied for keyboard-first navigation, grouping, and mobile/desktop composition. The local DOM implementation is in js/ui/v4/. Radix Colors and Motion mini are actual runtime dependencies with notices generated from installed packages. Geist is an unmodified OFL variable font served locally. Zed is a product-layout reference only; no Zed source or artwork is included.
